packet_reader: independent classic PCAP bytes; Internet checksum and exact pseudoheader seed

policy.partial_checksum: exact pseudoheader seed pattern; all containing flows quarantined; never repair bytes or features
policy.sibling_reconciliation: exact full reference counters, witnessed interval boundaries and source history/gap evidence for omitted partials
policy.incorrect_checksum: quarantine containing flow and invalidate affected reference conservation
policy.final_ack: immediately preceding opposite FIN+ACK pair, exact seq/ack modulo 2^32, second FIN at declared end, SF/Ff and exact full counters
policy.partition: every packet assigned exclusively; each reference fully accounted inside this flow; identical original/detailed labels
policy.unknown: no invented values or labels; full known reference counters required
policy.future_evaluation: never split connection_group_id or capture_group_id across evaluation partitions
